description:
This 2025 Toyota Tundra Limited represents a capable work truck and family hauler that delivers on reliability and performance. With an accident-free Carfax history as a one-owner vehicle, you can buy with confidence knowing this truck has been well maintained from day one.

- 12-speaker JBL Premium Audio system
- Power tilt/slide panoramic roof with power sunshade
- Trailer Backup Guide with Straight Path Assist
- TRD Off-Road Package for enhanced capability
- Towing Package for serious hauling needs
- Premium Package for added comfort and convenience
- TRD Front Skid Plate for undercarriage protection
- 20" TRD Alloy Wheels
- High Grade Full LED Headlamps with auto high-beam functionality
- Multi-Terrain Back Monitor for improved visibility
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Heated power door mirrors with auto-dimming capability
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS
- Safety Connect emergency communication (10-year trial)

Under the hood, the 3.4L V6 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD provides the power and traction you need for both highway driving and off-road adventures. The truck delivers 17 city and 22 highway MPG, balancing performance with reasonable fuel efficiency for this class.

The Limited trim elevates your driving experience with the JBL Premium Audio system that transforms every journey into a quality listening experience. Combined with SiriusXM satellite radio and full smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, you stay connected and entertained on every drive.

Safety and capability work together in this Tundra. The Trailer Backup Guide with Straight Path Assist takes the guesswork out of towing, while the Multi-Terrain Back Monitor provides clear visibility when reversing. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and brake assist technologies work behind the scenes to keep you secure in various driving conditions.

The TRD Off-Road Package and TRD Front Skid Plate speak to this truck's heritage of rugged capability, while the power panoramic roof with sunshade adds a touch of refinement to the cabin. Whether you're heading to the job site, planning a weekend adventure, or managing family duties, this Tundra handles every responsibility with proven Toyota durability.

We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this 2025 Tundra Limited firsthand. Our sales team is ready to discuss ownership options and answer any questions you may have about this exceptional truck.

Super Cruise capability provides advanced driving assistance, while the comprehensive camera suite includes bed view, surround vision, and trailer camera provisions. The integrated trailer brake controller, in-vehicle trailering app, and hitch guidance with hitch view simplify towing operations. Adaptive cruise control, lane keep assist with lane departure warning, and enhanced automatic emergency braking provide confidence on every journey.

The Multi-Flex tailgate offers six distinct configurations for loading flexibility, while the power-retractable assist steps lower automatically when you exit, enhancing access and convenience. Chrome recovery hooks and the integrated trailering system demonstrate this truck's capability for serious work. The Adaptive Ride Control suspension adjusts to varying terrain and conditions, delivering a composed ride whether loaded or unloaded.

Recently serviced and ready for immediate ownership, this High Country combines premium comfort, cutting-edge technology, and genuine truck capability in one impressive package. The 4WD system, dual active exhaust, and premium appointments make this an exceptional choice for buyers seeking the complete full-size truck experience without compromise.

Electronic stability control, traction control, brake assist, and dual front airbags provide foundation-level protection, while blind spot detection and cross-path monitoring add awareness during everyday driving. The rear parking assist system helps manage the truck's dimensions when maneuvering in tighter spaces.

This Gladiator Rubicon combines genuine truck utility with refined daily-driver amenities. This is a truck built for those who refuse to compromise between capability and comfort.

The EcoTec3 engine delivers 355 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque while utilizing advanced Dynamic Fuel Management technology that adjusts between 2 and 8 cylinders based on driving demands. The 8-speed automatic transmission pairs seamlessly with the 4WD system to provide smooth acceleration and confident handling across varied terrain.

Inside, the crew cab provides a welcoming environment with dual-zone automatic climate control, allowing driver and passenger to set individual temperature preferences. The 10-way power driver seat with lumbar adjustment ensures comfort during long drives, while heated seats and a heated steering wheel add convenience during colder months. The premium Bose sound system with SiriusXM 360L and HD Radio transforms your commute into an enjoyable experience.

Modern technology integration puts control at your fingertips through the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus system, featuring an 8-inch color touch screen, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto connectivity. The backup camera with bed view enhances safety and convenience during reversing and maneuvering. Multiple power outlets, including 120-volt options, keep your devices charged and ready.

This RST model combines work-ready features with genuine comfort and modern conveniences. With its powerful engine, advanced off-road capability, comprehensive technology package, and thoughtful interior design, this Silverado 1500 stands ready for whatever you demand. Visit our showroom to experience this truck firsthand and discover why it remains a trusted choice for truck buyers.

This 2020 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD LTZ delivers the capability and comfort you need for work and life. - Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 445 hp and 910 lb-ft torque
- LTZ Premium Package with convenience and safety features

Technology features include the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus system, HD Rear Vision Camera, automatic emergency braking, and multiple camera views designed to enhance your awareness and confidence on the road. The truck's advanced safety systems include dual front impact airbags, front and rear disc brakes with ABS, and electronic stability control.

Chrome tubular assist steps and chrome exterior trim reflect the LTZ's premium positioning, while the Chevytec spray-on bedliner protects your investment and cargo. With a 220-amp alternator and engine block heater, this truck is built for reliability in demanding conditions.

Whether you need a capable work truck or a comfortable daily driver with impressive capability, this 2020 Silverado 2500HD LTZ offers the features, performance, and quality you deserve. We invite you to experience this truck firsthand and discuss how it can serve your needs.

This 2020 Ram 3500 Limited represents serious capability paired with refined comfort, built for those who demand both performance and quality in their heavy-duty truck.

- Cummins 6.7L I6 Turbodiesel engine with 6-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- 17-speaker Harman Kardon premium sound system
- Adaptive cruise control with stop capability
- Surround view camera system with cargo view
- Trailer reverse guidance system
- Adaptive steering system
- Full-speed forward collision warning plus
- Lane keep assist
- Power sunroof
- GPS navigation with Uconnect 12.0 touchscreen
- Leather bucket seats with heating and ventilation
- Backup camera with park view
- Dual alternators rated at 440 amps
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 1-year Guardian trial
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility

The diesel powerplant under the hood delivers the reliability and torque the Ram 3500 is known for, backed by heavy-duty engine cooling and a Cummins turbo diesel badge that speaks to engineering excellence. The 4WD system ensures you maintain control in varied weather and terrain, while the transfer case skid plate shield provides undercarriage protection.

Inside, the white leather seats offer a premium driving environment, complemented by the 17-speaker audio system and heated steering wheel for enhanced comfort. The power sunroof adds an open-air dimension to the cabin, while automatic temperature control with dual front zones keeps everyone satisfied. Illuminated entry, memory seat adjustments, and a garage door transmitter round out the convenience features.

Safety technology is comprehensive, starting with the surround view camera system that provides visibility around the vehicle. Adaptive cruise control manages highway driving efficiently, while forward collision warning plus and lane keep assist actively work to prevent accidents. Electronic stability control, traction control, and all-wheel disc ABS braking provide foundational security in all conditions.

This truck was serviced here, ensuring proper maintenance records and care throughout its ownership. The combination of capability, technology, and luxury trim makes this Ram 3500 Limited ready for both worksites and weekend drives.

Visit us to experience how this truck delivers on its commitment to quality and performance.

This 2020 Ford F-250SD Lariat Super Duty combines capability with premium comfort to handle whatever demands you place on it.

- FX4 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and off-road tuned shock absorbers
- High Capacity Trailer Tow Package with 30,000 lbs GCW and upgraded axle
- 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package with integrated 7-pin connector
- Power Stroke 6.7L V8 Diesel Turbocharged engine with manual engine-exhaust braking
- Lariat Ultimate Package featuring power heated and ventilated seats with memory
- Voice-Activated Touchscreen Navigation System with SiriusXM Traffic and Travel Link
- PowerScope Trailer Tow Mirrors with memory and integrated heating
- 20" Bright Machined Cast Aluminum wheels
- Electronic-Locking differential with 3.55 axle ratio
- Intelligent Access with Push-Button Start
- Remote Start System and Remote Tailgate Release
- SYNC 3 Communications & Entertainment System with B&O audio by Bang & Olufsen
- Ambient Lighting and 6" Angular Chrome Step Bar
- Rear Parking Sensors with Exterior Parking Camera
- Dual front airbags, side airbags, and overhead airbags

The Power Stroke diesel engine delivers dependable performance for serious towing and hauling. The Lariat Ultimate Package elevates daily driving with power heated and ventilated front seats offering individual memory settings, so both driver and passenger enjoy personalized comfort every time you drive. Memory power-adjustable pedals and a power telescoping steering wheel with audio controls further refine the driving experience.

This truck's comprehensive safety and convenience features include SYNC 3 with voice commands for navigation and entertainment control, electronic stability control, brake assist, and 6-channel airbag protection. The rear parking sensors and reversing camera provide visibility when maneuvering in tight spaces.

Off-road capability is serious with the FX4 package, which includes specially tuned shock absorbers, transfer case skid plates, fuel tank protection, and hill descent control. The high-capacity trailer tow package increases towing capacity to 30,000 lbs and upgrades the axle for demanding applications. The 5th wheel hitch prep package adds five pickup bed attachment points and a driver's-side 7-pin connector for simplified connections.

The white exterior presents a clean appearance on job sites or at social gatherings. Chrome bumpers, heated power mirrors with integrated towing functions, and the angular chrome step bar add functional style. Twenty-inch bright machined cast aluminum wheels with magnetic painted pockets and bright hub covers complete the premium appearance.

Interior convenience features include a flow-through console, overhead console with six upfitter switches for custom electrical integration, leather steering wheel, and ambient lighting. The split folding rear seat maximizes cargo flexibility, while the 110V/400W outlet powers tools and equipment.

This F-250SD Lariat is ready for work or weekend adventure. View it at our dealership to experience the commanding presence and meticulous craftsmanship that define this premium Super Duty truck.

Inside the cab, luxury meets functionality with heated leather front seats featuring 10-way power adjustment and memory settings that recall your preferred positions. The heated steering wheel adds comfort during colder months, while dual-zone automatic temperature control ensures both driver and passenger ride at their ideal comfort level. Second-row heated seats extend that comfort to rear passengers.

The Raptor Technology Package elevates your driving experience with adaptive cruise control that automatically adjusts your speed, while the collision mitigation system helps protect you and your passengers. Voice-activated navigation through SYNC 3 keeps your attention on the road, and the system's pinch-to-zoom touchscreen puts all your controls within easy reach.

Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and electronic stability control work together to keep you planted and confident in any situation.

This Raptor is ready for whatever you ask of it—from the jobsite to the open road.

This 2017 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD LTZ represents a well-equipped heavy-duty truck built to handle demanding work and provide comfort during long days on the road. As a local trade, this Duramax-powered pickup combines proven capability with thoughtful features designed for professional and personal use.

- Duramax 6.6L Turbodiesel V8 engine with Allison 1000 6-speed automatic transmission
- Full-feature heated and vented perforated leather front bucket seats with 10-way power adjusters and lumbar control
- Premium Chevrolet MyLink audio system with 8" touchscreen, navigation, and SiriusXM satellite radio
- Chrome power-adjustable heated trailering mirrors with integrated turn signals and cargo lamps
- Custom Sport Edition with 20" polished aluminum wheels and spray-on bed liner
- Duramax Plus Package with engine block heater and exhaust brake
- Z71 Off-Road Package including hill descent control and Rancho shocks
- Driver Alert Package with lane departure warning and forward collision alert
- Ultrasonic front and rear park assist with rear vision camera
- Trailering provisions for camper, fifth wheel, and gooseneck trailers with integrated brake controller
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with heated front and rear windows
- 4-wheel disc brakes with electronic stability control and traction control
- 6" chromed rectangular assist steps and LED cargo box lighting

The heart of this truck is the Duramax 6.6L turbodiesel V8 paired with the Allison 1000 automatic transmission. This combination delivers the power and torque needed for towing and hauling while providing smooth, reliable operation. The 4WD system ensures capable performance in varied driving conditions, and the integrated trailer brake controller simplifies towing setup for campers and fifth wheels.

Interior accommodations reflect the LTZ trim's quality standards. The heated and vented leather bucket seats provide comfort during extended drives, with the driver's side featuring 10-way power adjustment and two-way power lumbar support. Memory functions allow you to save seating preferences, while wireless charging keeps compatible devices ready. Climate control maintains separate temperatures for driver and passenger comfort zones.

Technology and convenience features enhance both capability and ease of use. The MyLink audio system integrates navigation with SiriusXM satellite radio and smartphone connectivity through the touchscreen interface. The 4.2-inch driver information center displays trip data and vehicle diagnostics, while OnStar provides emergency services and remote vehicle access. Proximity keyless entry and remote starter allow convenient vehicle access and preconditioning.

Safety and visibility improvements include the Driver Alert Package, which combines lane departure warning and forward collision alert systems. The ultrasonic park assist with rear vision camera and cargo box lighting facilitates safe maneuvering and backing operations. The Z71 Off-Road Package adds hill descent control, helping maintain safe speeds when descending steep grades.

This Silverado 2500HD LTZ combines serious capability with refined comfort, making it suitable for those who need a truck that performs reliably while providing a quality driving environment. The thoughtful combination of work-focused features and creature comforts positions this vehicle as a practical choice for buyers seeking a full-size heavy-duty pickup.

2017 Ford F-350 Super Duty Platinum — Power Stroke Strength, Premium Comfort

Finished in Ruby Red Metallic with a Black and Brunello leather interior, this 77,019-mile F-350 Platinum pairs diesel capability with premium comfort. Its 6.7L Power Stroke turbodiesel, four-wheel drive, FX4 Off-Road Package, and factory towing technology suit work and long-distance travel.

⭐ Why You’ll Love It
• 6.7L Power Stroke V8 turbodiesel delivers working power.
• TorqShift six-speed automatic and 4x4 support confident capability.
• Platinum cabin includes heated and cooled leather front seats.
• FX4 equipment, locking rear axle, and skid plates add off-road readiness.
• Ultimate Trailer Tow Camera System improves trailering visibility.
• One-owner, accident-free CARFAX history adds confidence.

⚙️ Built for Demanding Jobs

The Power Stroke diesel works with a TorqShift automatic, 3.55 electronic-locking rear axle, manual locking hubs, and an 11,500-pound GVWR package. FX4 suspension, skid plates, dual heavy-duty alternators, upfitter switches, a spray-in bedliner, and factory towing technology support work and recreation.

Why This Vehicle Stands Out

This Platinum combines diesel strength with premium materials, advanced trailering visibility, and amenities beyond a traditional work truck. Ruby Red paint, a twin-panel moonroof, illuminated Platinum trim, and polished exterior details give it distinctive presence.

️ Premium Comfort
• Heated and cooled leather front seats with 10-way power adjustment.
• Driver memory, adjustable pedals, and heated steering wheel.
• Dual-zone automatic climate control and supplemental cab heater.
• Twin-panel power moonroof and ambient lighting.

Technology & Convenience
• SYNC 3 touchscreen with voice-activated navigation.
• Ultimate Trailer Tow Camera System and rear parking sensors.
• Power-sliding rear window and power telescoping tow mirrors.
• Intelligent Access with push-button start.

️ Safety & Control
• AdvanceTrac stability control with Roll Stability Control.
• Rearview camera and reverse-sensing system.
• Front, side, and Safety Canopy curtain airbags.
• Automatic headlamps, rain-sensing wipers, and SOS Post-Crash Alert.

CARFAX HISTORY

CARFAX reports no accidents or damage, one previous owner, personal use, 11 service records, and last ownership in North Carolina. Ask Liberty Ford Fayetteville for complete vehicle and inspection details.

Available at Liberty Ford Fayetteville, proudly serving Fayetteville, Fort Bragg, Hope Mills, Raeford, and nearby communities. Call 910-354-2029 today to schedule your test drive.

This 2017 Ford F-250SD Platinum in white presents a commanding presence on any road, combining premium capability with refined comfort for those who demand both professional-grade performance and luxury amenities.

- FX4 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and Rancho Branded Shocks
- Platinum Ultimate Package with Adaptive Cruise Control and Collision Warning
- Ultimate Trailer Tow Camera System with 360-degree camera and trailer reverse guidance
- 6.7L Power Stroke V8 Diesel Turbocharged engine with manual push-button engine-exhaust braking
- Twin Panel Power Moonroof
- Lane-Keeping Alert
- SYNC 3 Communications & Entertainment System with Navigation
- Unique Platinum Leather 40/Console/40 Seats with heated and ventilated front seats
- Electronic-Locking differential with 3.55 axle ratio
- 20" Polished Aluminum Wheels
- Rear CHMSL Camera with cargo light
- Heated steering wheel and heated rear seats
- Premium Sony Audio System with SiriusXM Radio
- Dual front and side impact airbags with overhead airbag
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror with compass

The Power Stroke diesel engine delivers the torque and capability this truck is engineered to provide, paired with a TorqShift 6-speed automatic transmission in a 4WD configuration. With over 87,000 miles on the odometer, this F-250SD has been maintained as a working truck that still offers years of service ahead. The FX4 Off-Road Package distinguishes this model with specialized suspension tuning, skid plate protection, and genuine off-road capability when the job demands it.

The cabin reflects Platinum-level refinement with premium leather seating, dual-zone automatic climate control, and driver-oriented technology. Adaptive cruise control works seamlessly with collision warning systems to enhance safety during highway miles, while the heated and ventilated front seats provide comfort through varying seasons. The moonroof adds an unexpected dimension of light and openness to the cab experience.

For those who tow regularly, the Ultimate Trailer Tow Camera System represents genuine peace of mind. The 360-degree camera array and trailer reverse guidance technology make backing into tight spots or navigating complex job sites considerably more manageable. The rear CHMSL camera provides continuous visibility to what's behind you, a feature that pays dividends in demanding work environments.

The electronic-locking differential with 3.55 axle ratio ensures traction when terrain becomes challenging, while the Hill Descent Control from the FX4 package offers controlled descent on steep grades. Combined with the truck's substantial payload capacity and engineering, this F-250SD handles both everyday hauling and serious off-road work with equal competence.

This Platinum edition represents the intersection of capability and comfort—a truck built for those who refuse to compromise between professional-grade performance and the refinements that make time in the cab more enjoyable. We invite you to visit and experience how this F-250SD aligns with your vision for a dependable, well-equipped diesel truck.

This 2500 Laramie represents a well-equipped truck that balances work capability with daily comfort. Electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist work together to maintain control in challenging conditions. The low tire pressure warning system and Emergency Communication System with Safety Connect provide added security.

This 2025 Tacoma TRD Off-Road stands ready to serve as your capable partner for work, weekend trips, or daily driving. We welcome the opportunity to show you this truck and discuss how it fits your needs.

This 2025 GMC Sierra 1500 SLT delivers the capability and comfort you need for work and life. Multiple USB ports and a Wi-Fi hotspot capability keep you connected. LED cargo area lighting illuminates your work space, while perimeter lighting helps with nighttime visibility. The spray-in bed liner protects your investment.

At 45,335 miles, this Sierra 1500 SLT is ready to take on your next challenge. With the Trailering Package and proven V8 reliability, you're getting a truck built to handle real work and real life. This is a vehicle designed for those who demand capability without compromise.

This Silverado 1500 WT arrives in clean white exterior finish, ready to make an impression on any job site or in your daily routine. The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine delivers dependable performance while maintaining respectable fuel economy at 16 MPG city and 21 MPG highway. The 10-speed automatic transmission provides smooth gear transitions and operational efficiency across various driving conditions. Rear-wheel drive provides the foundation for the truck's practical handling characteristics.

The automatic emergency braking system works to help prevent collisions, while forward collision alert and lane keep assist with lane departure warning provide additional layers of awareness. IntelliBeam automatic high beam technology adapts your headlights to traffic conditions. The HD rear vision camera displays when backing, and traction control with electronic stability control helps maintain grip in challenging situations.

Technology integration makes this truck practical for modern drivers. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system includes Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, allowing seamless smartphone integration. Bluetooth connectivity handles hands-free phone calls and audio streaming. Speed-sensing power steering and electronic cruise control ease the workload during extended drives. The 3.5" monochromatic driver information center keeps you informed about vital truck functions.

Standard features demonstrate the value built into this WT model. The locking tailgate with EZ lift power lock and release simplifies cargo operations. Front frame-mounted black recovery hooks are practical for work scenarios. Power windows, power door mirrors, and remote keyless entry add daily convenience. Heated outside mirrors prepare you for colder weather, while solar absorbing tinted glass helps manage cabin temperature during sunny days.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the 2025 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 WT firsthand and discuss how it can serve your transportation needs.

Meet the 2025 GMC Sierra 1500 Pro, a capable work truck built for those who demand reliability and performance in their daily operations.

- 10-Way Power Driver Seat with Lumbar Support
- Adaptive Cruise Control
- 120-Volt Interior Power Outlet (400 watts)
- 120-Volt Bed Mounted Power Outlet
- Push Button Start
- Remote Keyless Entry
- EZ Lift Power Lock & Release Tailgate
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- HD Rear Vision Camera
- Electric Rear-Window Defogger
- OnStar Services Capable
- Wi-Fi Hotspot Capable
- Front Frame-Mounted Black Recovery Hooks
- 17" Silver Painted Aluminum Wheels
- 2.7L Turbocharged EcoTec3 Engine with 310 Horsepower

This Sierra 1500 Pro is finished in a professional Thunderstorm Gray that maintains its appearance while resisting dirt and dust common on job sites. As a local trade-in from a non-smoker, this truck has been well-maintained and treated with care. The gray exterior is complemented by deep-tinted glass and solar-absorbing tinted windows, providing comfort during long workdays.

Under the hood sits a 2.7L turbocharged four-cylinder engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission. The 4WD system features a two-speed electronic AutoTrac transfer case with push-button control, delivering the traction you need on varied terrain. Combined with the standard suspension package and trailering capability, this truck handles loaded beds and challenging conditions with confidence.

The cabin prioritizes comfort and functionality with a 10-way power driver seat featuring lumbar support, allowing you to adjust your seating position for maximum comfort during extended drives. The truck includes two 120-volt power outlets—one in the bed and one in the cabin—giving you 400 watts of shared power for tools and equipment. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep you connected while dual front air curtain airbags and OnStar emergency communication systems prioritize safety.

Advanced driver assistance features come standard, including Adaptive Cruise Control, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning, Automatic Emergency Braking, and Forward Collision Alert. The HD rearview camera and hitch guidance system simplify maneuvering in tight spaces, whether you're backing into a loading dock or parking in a crowded lot.

The Pro Value Package bundles genuine value with the Convenience Package and Trailering Package included. Chrome front bumpers, frame-mounted recovery hooks, and a rear step bumper are built to withstand the demands of work environments. LED cargo area lighting illuminates your load area when needed, and the EZ Lift power tailgate reduces strain on your back during loading and unloading.

This 2025 GMC Sierra 1500 Pro delivers the straightforward capability professionals expect from GMC, backed by proven engineering and practical features designed for your workday. Visit our showroom to take this truck for a test drive and see how it fits your needs.

Meet the 2025 Chevrolet Colorado Trail Boss, a capable mid-size truck designed for buyers who demand both on-road refinement and off-road readiness. This gray Trail Boss combines practical engineering with the features you need to tackle work and weekend adventures with confidence.

- 2.7L Turbocharged EcoTec3 Engine with 310 horsepower
- 4-Wheel Drive capability
- 18" Black High Gloss Aluminum Wheels
- Heated Power Door Mirrors
- Bedliner with Integral Storage Compartments
- 11.3" Advanced Color LCD Display with Navigation
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- Automatic Emergency Braking and Forward Collision Alert
- Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning
- Chevy Safety Assist suite of technology
- Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control
- SiriusXM satellite radio with trial subscription
- Remote Start Kit with two key fobs

The Trail Boss pairs a 2.7L turbocharged four-cylinder engine with an 8-speed automatic transmission, delivering 310 horsepower with expected fuel economy ratings of 18 mpg city and 23 mpg highway. The 4-wheel drive system provides the traction you need whether you're navigating wet roads or exploring unpaved terrain. This truck maintains a modern stance, with its gray exterior complemented by gloss black tailgate lettering and 18-inch aluminum wheels that balance durability with refined appearance.

Inside, the cabin emphasizes practicality without sacrificing comfort. Front bucket seats with a center armrest accommodate two passengers comfortably, while the split-folding rear seat provides flexible cargo options. The 11.3-inch touchscreen display serves as the command center for the truck's infotainment system, seamlessly integrating navigation, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto so you stay connected on every trip. SiriusXM satellite radio keeps you entertained across the entire continent.

Safety features are comprehensive and standard. Automatic Emergency Braking with Forward Collision Alert works alongside Lane Keep Assist and Lane Departure Warning to help you maintain control. The truck includes dual front and side airbags, high-strength steel frame reinforcement, and the Chevy Safety Assist package, which bundles multiple protective technologies. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control enhance grip during acceleration and cornering.

Practical touches distinguish this Trail Boss for real-world ownership. The bedliner features integral storage compartments that organize equipment and protect bed integrity. Remote Start capability with two key fobs means you can warm the cabin or prepare climate control before you leave your home. Heated power mirrors improve visibility during winter months, while automatic high-beam headlights reduce driver fatigue during longer drives.

The 2025 Chevrolet Colorado Trail Boss delivers dependable truck capability with the refinements expected in today's market. Come see this capable machine at our showroom and test drive it yourself to experience its blend of performance, technology, and comfort.

  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. The 2025 Toyota Tacoma SR5 represents a capable truck built to handle demanding work and outdoor adventures with reliability and confidence.

This model comes equipped with thoughtful features designed for both utility and comfort:

The SR5 Upgrade Package elevates the ownership experience with modern conveniences. The Integrated Trailer Brake Controller simplifies towing operations with dedicated controls displayed on the multi-information screen. HomeLink integration enables seamless garage door access directly from your truck.

Performance and capability define the Tacoma's character. The 2.4L 4-cylinder engine pairs with an 8-speed automatic transmission to deliver practical power delivery. Four-wheel drive gives you the ability to navigate varied terrain and weather conditions with assurance. The truck achieves 19 city and 24 highway MPG, balancing capability with reasonable fuel efficiency.

Safety features provide peace of mind for every journey. The truck includes dual front and side impact airbags, emergency communication through Safety Connect with a one-year trial, rear parking camera, electronic stability control, and traction control. Features like anti-whiplash front head restraints and knee airbags demonstrate Toyota's comprehensive approach to occupant protection.

This SR5 truck combines practical capability with modern convenience in a dependable package. The combination of thoughtful features, proven performance, and intelligent design makes this an excellent choice for those seeking a versatile vehicle. Visit our showroom to experience the Tacoma firsthand and discuss how it meets your needs.

- All Wheel Drive (AWD)
- 2.5L Hybrid Engine with 40 city / 34 highway MPG
- Leather Seats with Heating Function
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Navigation System with Connected Navigation
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with SiriusXM 360L
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition
- 4K Tow Package with Trailer Brake Controller and Class III Hitch
- Blind Spot Monitor and Lane Departure Warning
- Forward Collision Alert
- Keyless Access with Push Button Start
- Remote Start Capability
- Backup Camera with Rear Parking Assistance
- 19" Machined Painted Aluminum Alloy Wheels

The hybrid powertrain delivers a practical balance of performance and fuel economy, allowing you to maximize efficiency without sacrificing capability. With 40 MPG in city driving conditions, this Maverick reduces your fuel expenses while maintaining the truck utility you need. The AWD system provides confident traction across various road conditions, making this vehicle adaptable to your daily environment.

The Lariat trim elevates your driving experience with premium features that enhance both comfort and control. Heated leather seats and a heated steering wheel ensure comfort during cooler months, while the power driver seat allows personalized positioning. The automatic climate control system maintains your preferred temperature automatically, and the premium B&O audio system transforms your daily commute with exceptional sound quality.

Safety and convenience technology are integrated throughout this truck. The forward collision alert, blind spot monitor, and lane departure warning work together to provide awareness on the road. The backup camera with rear parking assistance simplifies maneuvering, while the SYNC 4 system with voice recognition lets you control functions safely without taking your hands from the wheel. Navigation is built in, eliminating the need for separate devices.

The 4K Tow Package transforms this Maverick into a capable hauler. The Class III trailer hitch with both 4-pin and 7-pin connectors accommodates a variety of trailers, while the transmission oil cooler and upgraded cooling fan ensure consistent performance under load. The trailer brake controller provides precise braking synchronization when towing. This comprehensive package means you're ready for genuine work demands.

This Maverick has been driven just over 10,000 miles and includes the Forever Warranty, providing long-term peace of mind with your purchase. The combination of efficiency, towing capability, and premium comfort features makes this an exceptional value. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the practical benefits this truck delivers for your lifestyle.

Climate control and power windows provide daily comfort, while the power rear window offers flexibility for bed access.

Safety technology is built in, featuring an HD rear vision camera, automatic emergency braking, lane keep assist with departure warning, and forward pedestrian braking. The electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain secure handling. The truck is also OnStar capable, offering emergency services and vehicle diagnostics at your fingertips.

This Silverado 1500 Custom is ready to serve as your reliable partner for daily commuting, weekend projects, or serious work. The 2025 Toyota Tacoma SR5 is a versatile truck built to handle your toughest demands while delivering the reliability you expect from Toyota.

- 2.4L 4-Cylinder with 8-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- JBL Premium Audio System with 8" Toyota Audio Multimedia
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- Auto High-beam Headlights with Front Fog Lights
- Four Wheel Independent Suspension
- Exterior Parking Camera with Rear Step Bumper
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Heated Power Door Mirrors with Auto-Dimming Rear-View Mirror
- Dual Front Impact Airbags with Side Impact Protection
- Remote Keyless Entry and Steering Wheel Audio Controls

- Split Folding Rear Seat with Front Center Armrest
- 17" Styled Alloy Wheels

This SR5 combines capability with comfort, offering the performance you need on any terrain. Whether navigating city streets or exploring off-road territory, the truck responds to your needs with stability and control.

The modern infotainment system keeps you connected with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while the JBL Premium Audio ensures quality sound on every journey. Climate control features, including heated door mirrors and rear window defroster, address weather challenges throughout the year. Illuminated entry and the auto-dimming rearview mirror enhance convenience during all driving conditions.

Safety has been engineered into every aspect of this truck. Multiple airbags, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to protect you and your passengers. The rearview camera provides additional visibility when backing, while the Toyota Safety Connect system offers emergency assistance when you need it most.

With 19 city MPG and 24 highway MPG, this 4WD truck delivers reasonable fuel efficiency for its class. The 3.583 axle ratio provides the pulling power necessary for real work without sacrificing everyday drivability.

The Tacoma SR5 represents a practical investment in a truck that works as hard as you do. Visit us today to experience the capability and quality that make the Tacoma a trusted choice for truck buyers.

This 2025 Ford F-150 XLT in White combines capable truck performance with the features you need for work and daily driving.

- 5.0L V8 Engine with Auto Start-Stop Technology
- 10-Speed Automatic Transmission with 4WD
- Equipment Group 301A with Chrome Door & Tailgate Handles
- 6" Angular Bright Anodized Step Bar
- Chrome Single-Tip Exhaust
- Dual-Zone Electronic Automatic Temperature Control
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition
- SiriusXM 360L Satellite Radio
- Rear Parking Sensors
- Auto High-Beam Headlights with Front Fog Lights
- 18" Chrome-Like PVD Wheels
- Heated Power Door Mirrors
- Remote Keyless Entry with Illuminated Entry
- Dual Front Impact and Side Impact Airbags
- FordPass Connect 5G with Internet Access

The F-150 XLT delivers the dependable power you expect from Ford's truck lineup. The 5.0L V8 generates strong performance whether you're hauling cargo or navigating daily routes, while the 10-speed automatic transmission provides smooth shifting and efficiency. Four-wheel drive gives you confidence in various road conditions, and the 3.31 axle ratio is engineered to handle the truck's capabilities.

Inside, the cabin offers comfort and convenience features designed for long days on the job or the road. SYNC 4 keeps you connected with smartphone integration and voice controls, while SiriusXM 360L satellite radio provides entertainment options. Dual-zone climate control ensures driver and passenger comfort, and the telescoping steering wheel adjusts to your preference.

Safety is built in with comprehensive airbag coverage, electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist working together to help protect occupants. Rear parking sensors assist when backing up, and the emergency communication system provides added peace of mind on your travels.

The exterior styling reflects the XLT's no-nonsense character. Chrome details on the door handles, tailgate, and bumpers provide visual appeal, while the 6" step bar and 18" wheels complete the look. The wrapped steering wheel and black painted grille with chrome center bar add refinement to the truck's appearance.

With 17 city and 22 highway MPG, this F-150 XLT offers reasonable fuel economy for a V8-powered truck. The auto start-stop technology helps improve efficiency during city driving, reducing unnecessary fuel consumption.

This F-150 XLT is ready to work hard and serve you well. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the capability and comfort this truck delivers.

The 2025 Chevrolet Colorado LT is built to deliver capability and comfort in a midsize truck package. Finished in gray exterior, this Colorado features a 2.7-liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine producing 310 horsepower paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission and rear-wheel drive. With city fuel economy of 20 MPG and highway ratings of 24 MPG, this truck balances performance with efficiency.

The interior combines functionality with thoughtful amenities designed for both workdays and weekend adventures. The LT Convenience Package includes an 11-speaker audio system, wireless phone charging, and an integrated technology suite. The infotainment system features an 11.3-inch advanced color display with navigation, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto compatibility. Climate control is independently adjustable for driver and front passenger comfort, while heated front seats add warmth during colder months. The heated steering wheel and tilt/telescoping steering column accommodate various driver preferences.

Safety and convenience are priorities throughout the Colorado's design. Chevy Safety Assist includes automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, lane keep assist with lane departure warning, and rear pedestrian alert. Additional features include blind zone steering assist calibrated for trailering, HD surround vision camera, and an integrated trailer brake controller. OnStar emergency communication provides peace of mind on the road.

Trailering capability is enhanced through the Advanced Trailering Package, which includes a trailering app, automatic locking rear differential, and integrated brake control. The spray-on bed liner protects the cargo area while maintaining a professional appearance. Black accent packages include gloss black tailgate lettering, black assist steps, and a Chevrolet Performance black exhaust tip. Seventeen-inch argent metallic aluminum wheels complete the purposeful exterior styling.

Comfort and utility extend to the cargo area with a 120-volt bed-mounted power outlet and 120-volt rear console power outlet, providing convenient charging options. The rear center armrest and dual rear USB charging ports enhance passenger convenience. Front bucket seats with adjustable lumbar support, along with the split-folding rear seat, provide flexibility for both passengers and cargo.

This is the kind of Tacoma we are always searching for.

Finished in beautiful Lunar Mist Metallic over a pristine Moon Mist interior, this 2000 Toyota Tacoma Regular Cab 4x4 is powered by Toyota’s legendary 2.7L four-cylinder and paired with the highly desirable 5-speed manual transmission. With only 62K original miles, this truck is an absolute Southern California diamond and is about as clean as they come.

Discover the 2025 Hyundai Santa Cruz XRT, a distinctive compact truck that combines capable performance with thoughtful design. This Red exterior model delivers a refined driving experience with its 2.5L I4 engine paired with Shiftronic automatic transmission and available all-wheel drive, achieving an impressive 18 city and 26 highway MPG for balanced efficiency.

- Heated front bucket seats with H-Tex leatherette trim
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto integration
- Navigation system with backup camera
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- 18-inch alloy wheels with XRT-exclusive design
- Remote keyless entry and illuminated entry
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Speed control and tilt/telescoping steering wheel
- Rear step bumper and cross rails
- SiriusXM AM/FM/HD audio system with 6 speakers
- Electronic stability control with traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with auto-leveling
- Full suite of airbags including side and overhead protection
- Bed cargo net and wheel locks

The Santa Cruz XRT interior prioritizes comfort and convenience with heated front seats ideal for cooler months, dual-zone climate control, and an intuitive infotainment system featuring Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The leather-appointed steering wheel and shift knob elevate the cabin feel, while the navigation system and backup camera support confident daily driving and maneuvering in tight spaces.

Performance and handling are refined with four-wheel independent suspension, electronic stability control, and speed-sensing steering that adapts to your driving conditions. The all-wheel drive system enhances traction and control in varied weather, while the 18-inch alloy wheels showcase XRT-exclusive styling and contribute to the truck's purposeful stance.

Safety remains paramount with a comprehensive airbag system spanning dual front impact, front side impact, rear side impact, and overhead protection. Electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain stability, while the low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed. Additional conveniences include the emergency communication system with Bluelink+, panic alarm, and security system.

The truck bed combines practicality with thoughtful features including cross rails for securing cargo and a bed cargo net to prevent shifting loads. Carpeted floor mats protect the interior, while the rear step bumper facilitates access to the truck bed. Heated door mirrors and rear window defroster add functionality for year-round driving.

This 2025 Santa Cruz XRT represents a smart choice for those seeking a truck that balances style, efficiency, and capability. With approximately 11,100 miles, this vehicle is ready for your next chapter. Visit our showroom to experience the Santa Cruz XRT firsthand and discover how it fits your lifestyle.
